Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Camera Supply
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Security Manager, Smith & Sons Camera Supply, (555) 123-4567, johndoe@smithsons.com
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Camera Supply specializes in providing a wide range of high-quality cameras, photography equipment, and accessories for both amateur and professional photographers. Our operations include a retail storefront where customers can explore and test our products, as well as an online platform for convenient purchasing. We also offer photography workshops and events aimed at enhancing customers' skills and knowledge in photography. Our store is equipped with state-of-the-art security measures, including a professionally monitored alarm system, security cameras, and controlled access to ensure the safety of our inventory and our clients. We are committed to maintaining a safe environment for our employees and customers through ongoing training programs focused on loss prevention and safety protocols.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2022, a burglary occurred at our retail location when the store was closed. The intruder accessed the premises by force, resulting in the theft of approximately $5,000 worth of camera equipment and accessories. The incident was reported to the local police, and an insurance claim was filed. The claim is currently under review, with a status of "Pending." We have since upgraded our security system to include more advanced surveillance and monitoring tools to prevent future incidents.

Underwriting Guidelines:
3.115
Video & Media Stores
Underwriting Appetite
• Preferred:
– Established businesses with at least 3 years of continuous operation and a demonstrated
low loss history.
– Premises equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system, including burglar and
fire alarms.
– Locations with controlled access, adequate lighting, and security cameras to deter theft
and vandalism.
– Businesses that maintain comprehensive employee training programs focused on safety
and loss prevention.
• Acceptable:
– Specialty or niche video/media stores, including those operating primarily online or
hosting occasional special events, provided appropriate endorsements are added.
– Stores with moderate loss history but with clear mitigation measures implemented.
– Businesses that have recently upgraded security systems or improved operational controls
but have less than 3 years tenure.
• Not Acceptable:
– Businesses without any alarm or security systems in place.
